cultivation.defying-the-heavens.npc.gree: %s glares at you with open killing intent.
%s regards you calmly and goes back to their own affairs.
%s nods to you: "May your path be clear and your heart steady."
%s sits in deep seclusion and does not stir.
We're under attack! To arms, disciples!
Someone's knocking on our barrier. Let's answer.
The barrier! Kill whoever's out there!
A thief! I'll take their hands!
Someone's in our treasury. Slowly, now. Make it hurt.
Touch one more thing and I'll break your fingers.
Hold! You trespass on sect grounds!
Sect Master! Long may you reign.
Sect Master %s! This disciple pays respects.
Ha! Stronger! Let them all tremble!
I... I've broken through! The heavens are kind!
The bottleneck gives way! My thanks to my teachers!
If I walk that patrol ring one more time, I'll burn it down.
The patrol found wolf tracks by the east path.
I'll tell the Elders. Stay alert tonight, %1$s.
One day I'll sit in %2$s's seat.
Say that louder. I'd love to watch.
They live on qi and disapproval.
The Elders carry burdens we cannot see.
They say %2$s once fought a demon for three days.
And won without spilling a drop of innocent blood, I heard.
Which disciple will you discipline today, %1$s?
The one who yawned in my lecture.
If the righteous come, let them come.
I've been saving a technique just for them.
The young ones grow quickly this year, %1$s.
If they keep their hearts steady, the sect is in good hands.
Thanks to the veins beneath us, and our care.
And did you eat the bird?
Truly? Heaven provides for those who seek.
Then I look excellent in it.
The cook put in too much chilli again.
Saw a fox in the garden.
Leave it. It eats the rats.
The plum trees will flower soon.
I look forward to it. A calm heart sees beauty everywhere.
%1$s, the kitchen made steamed buns today.
Then I know where I'm going after meditation.
%1$s, I'll reach the next stage before you.
I hear your circulation stumbled again.
Who told you? I'll cut out their tongue.
%1$s, lend me your mat? Mine's worn thin.
My qi ran a full circuit without stumbling today.
Congratulations, %1$s! Your diligence is paying off.
%1$s, do you ever doubt the path?
Every day. Then I sit down and cultivate anyway.
Did you see the Immortals flying overhead?
Nice robe. Where'd you get it?
From the last one who asked.
Not for long, if you keep following me.
If I had, would I tell you?
Where does your road lead, fellow Daoist?
Have you passed any sects nearby?
One, a few days back. They keep good manners.
I'd like to see what %2$s is made of.
Did you see %2$s at the gates?
Then we should treat our guest well, %1$s.
(whispering) If the Elder looks away, we leave.
(whispering) How long have we been sitting?
(whispering) That is the Dao entering you.
Hmph. Congratulations, %s. Don't let it go to your head.
%s broke through? ...I'm happy for you. Really.
Morning already? Who rang that cursed bell?
Another day, another fool to beat.
Dawn. The morning qi is the purest.
Up, up! The bell has rung.
The lamps are lit. Off to bed.
The best things happen after dark.
The day is done. Rest well.
Another day of cultivation behind us.
Turn back, or don't. I'm bored either way.
One step closer and you're my afternoon's entertainment.
Halt, traveller. State your business with our sect.
Visitors are welcome. Thieves are not.
Ah, %s. In you go, before I change my mind.
%s! The gates are open to you.
Who dares kill %s? I'll flay them!
%s... I swear you will be avenged.
Enough. Get out of my sight and get stronger.
Dismissed. Try not to die before tomorrow.
That is all for today. Go, and cultivate diligently.
The Dao favours the strong. Be strong, or be someone's stepping stone.
Mercy is a debt your enemy collects later. With interest.
Steal a technique once and it's theft. Master it and it's yours.
Heaven is not your friend. It's a rival with better weather.
Your heart demons feed on hesitation. Starve them. Decide, and act.
Every senior you bow to is a senior you will one day surpass.
Circulate your qi through all twelve meridians before you sleep. Every night.
Talent is a head start. Persistence decides the race.
Don't force a breakthrough. Fill the vessel first.
Know your realm, and your enemy's. Most deaths are simple arithmetic.
Pills help. Pills also poison. Learn which is which.
Meditate where the qi is dense: on mats, near old herbs, up high. Use your head.
Sit down and be quiet. Today you might even learn something.
Eyes on me. The first to doze spars with me.
Settle your breath. Today we speak of the Dao.
Sit straight, disciples. Let us begin.
Elder, is it true the strong can eat the qi of the weak?
Elder, what if my senior is in my way?
Elder, how long should a session last?
Elder, does the mat really make a difference?
Elder, how does one know when the foundation is truly firm?
Elder, what if one's heart wavers at the bottleneck?
Qi follows intent, and intent follows the heart. Cultivate the heart first.
A tree grows by the inch. Do not envy the bamboo its speed.
When you breathe in, take in Heaven. When you breathe out, return what is not yours.
A bottleneck is not a wall. It is a door you have not yet learned to open.
Virtue steadies the foundation. Without it, every realm you climb is a cliff's edge.
Heaven tests those it values. Welcome your tribulations.
You owed me three spirit stones, %s. I forgive you.
Rest well, %s. May your next life be gentler.
We will carry on your cultivation, %s.
Heavens... I can hardly breathe near them.
Immortal, please, spare this humble one!
S-senior... this one is only passing through!
What a monstrous aura... don't look at it.
Such a presence... this junior greets Senior!
The air itself grows heavy... a true expert.
Please, Immortal, we want no trouble.
Hide the rice, it's that one again.
I remember your face. Fondly. Like a debt.
I have not forgotten what you did.
What a strange fruit... it glows!
Oh my, that fruit smells like heaven.
Mm, that fruit smells delicious. So do you.
Give me that fruit and I'll forget your face.
Eat it or hide it. Don't carry it about.
I can feel the years in that fruit from here.
A Cultivation Fruit? Guard it well.
What a tiny little aura. Adorable.
Run along before I get hungry.
Work hard, little one. The path is long.
A junior. Keep your heart steady.
Mind your footing on this mountain, junior.
Well, if it isn't %s. Still alive, I see.
%s! My favourite guest. Don't make me regret it.
%s! You honour us with a visit.
A mortal. How brave. How stupid.
Fresh meat, walking about on its own.
Mortal. I could use a new servant.
A mortal. Stay out from underfoot.
A mortal? Keep to the path; these mountains are dangerous.
Mortal friend, mind the beasts after dark.
Few mortals come this far. Be careful.
An outsider. Did you lose your way, or your mind?
Wander a little further. I'd like to watch.
Visitors here tend to stay. Forever.
A guest on our mountain? Mind the sect's rules.
Visitors should present themselves at the main hall.
An outsider... welcome, but don't wander.
Keep your hands where I can see them.
Looking for trouble? You found the right place.
Heavens, it shines like the moon!
My, what a pretty %s. Shame if someone took it.
That %s would look better in my hand.
That %s will get you killed. Put it away.
Is that a %s? Keep it hidden, friend.
My knees said it would rain.
Rain. Washes the blood away, at least.
Who decided we patrol in this muck?
If anything attacks now, I'm letting it.
A disciple's duty doesn't wait for fair weather.
Rain or not, the perimeter must be walked.
Rain. The herbs will be glad of it.
Heaven waters the earth; a good sign.
Let it rain. The qi is fresh after rain.
Take the offering and open the way. I'm not asking twice.
Heavens. I ask your permission to cultivate on.
Here's my offering. Let me through.
Heavens above, hear this humble disciple.
I offer what I have. Grant me the way forward.
Stingy heavens. Fine. Again at dawn.
Silence... I am not ready yet. Tomorrow, then.
The heavens turn away. I must be more sincere.
Ha! Even the heavens know better than to refuse me.
The heavens have answered! My thanks, my thanks!
The way is open. I won't waste it.
%s! Let's see if you've improved. I doubt it.
Next time I won't hold back, %s.
Enjoy it, %s. It won't happen twice.
I concede, %s. Your sword is swift.
You have bested me, %s. I will reflect on it.
Your guard drops on the left, %s.
Well fought, %s. Your stance is improving.
Ha! Some fool is being struck down by Heaven.
Listen to it roar. Heaven is jealous again.
Thunder... is someone facing their tribulation?
Heaven's wrath stirs. Be humble today.
My watch. Pray nothing interesting happens. Or do.
Go and sleep. I'll guard your precious gate.
I'll keep the gate. Rest well.
My watch begins. Heaven keep us.
Your gate now. Try not to lose it.
The watch passes on. It's been quiet.
All is well. The gate is yours.

Take tribute while your realm presses on them. They'll hate you for it, and your path darkens.
Give what you hold. Old herbs, fine pills and Cultivation Fruit please the weak most; the strong are harder to impress.
Bow, or cup your fist, as befits the two of you. Good manners are remembered, once a day.
Insult them. They will think less of you, and they may decide to teach you a lesson.
Lift your pressure off them, and let them stand.
A bout to first blood: it ends when either of you has lost a quarter of their health. Set terms: friendly, a wager on what you hold, or at their full strength.
Let them live. They owe you a life, and your path brightens.
Barter for spirit stones. They sell by their station, buy herbs, pills and fruit from you, and the better they like you, the better the deal.

cultivation.defying-the-heavens.talk.lin: Me, Immortal? I know very little, but ask.
Ask away, friend.
Questions cost nothing. Answers might.
Senior wishes to know? Ask, ask.
You want something from me? How bold. Ask, before I lose interest.
This one will hold nothing back from Senior!
A curious mortal. Ask; it amuses me.
Ask. I'll decide what's true.
Ask.
Ask, Senior.
Be brief.
Senior need only ask.
What does a mortal want to know?
What would you know?
Questions? Ask, then. I have a little time.
Senior may ask anything.
Speak quickly, junior. This one has little time.
Whatever Senior wishes to know, this one will answer.
Ask, then. Briefly.
Ask, fellow Daoist. I'll answer what I can.
This is too much, Immortal. Thank you!
Now this is a proper gift.
Useful. My thanks.
This is generous. I won't forget it.
I... I don't know what to say. Thank you, Immortal!
Ha! You do understand how the world works.
This is worth a great deal. I'll remember it.
Such a treasure... this one is in your debt.
I couldn't take that, Immortal.
Are you mocking me?
What would I do with that?
This one cannot accept that.
For me? Thank you, Immortal.
Is that all?
Hm. Thank you.
A kind thought. Thank you.
Greetings, Immortal. Safe travels.
Good day to you, traveller.
Little one, you have manners. They might even keep you alive.
Senior... this one meant no offence. None at all.
An ant that bows. How sweet. Crawl along.
S-senior! This worthless one greets Senior!
A mortal, walking right up to me. Brave, or stupid?
Fellow Daoist. Tea? It isn't poisoned. Probably.
Junior. What is it?
Senior. This one is listening.
Hm.
Senior's presence is... considerable. How can this one help?
A mortal. Keep out from underfoot and no one will trouble you.
Fellow Daoist. Tea's hot, if you want it.
Well met, little friend. Your foundation looks steady.
Senior honours this one by stopping. Please, be at ease.
Junior. Keep to the path and mind your manners on this mountain.
This junior greets Senior! What does Senior require?
A mortal this far up? Go carefully, and keep to the path.
Fellow Daoist. Sit and take some tea with me; may your path be clear and your heart steady.
Greedy. Come back tomorrow.
Enough for today.
That is enough for one day. Let it settle.
You force your qi like a drunk forcing a door. Coax it. There: free advice.
Your circulation stumbles at the third meridian. Fix it.
Breathe out slower than you breathe in, and let the qi settle at the dantian before you push. Sit with that.
The %1$s, on the %2$s path, lies %3$s of here, %4$s blocks or so.
The %1$s, %2$s-path dogs, are %3$s of here, %4$s blocks or so. Keep clear of them.
No sect that I know of, not within a few days on foot.
Guarding the treasury and the core: %1$s. Sect Master %2$s keeps the main hall.
There is no one else to answer for this sect.
Our gates are kept by %s.
Guarding the treasury and the core: %1$s. The main hall is mine.
Sect Master %1$s keeps the main hall. We have no elders now.
Guarding the treasury and the core: %1$s. We have no master now.
That's enough! I won't be spoken to like that!
I was hoping you'd say that.
You'll regret that.
Then let your blade speak for you!
Please, Immortal, I don't want any trouble.
Barking at me? Cute.
I've no time for fools.
Your words dirty only yourself.
Thank you, immortal, thank you!
Hah. Generous of you.
...Thank you.
Senior is merciful. This one thanks you.
Nothing, I fear. Quiet times.
Gossip? Go bore someone else.
Nothing new.
I've heard nothing worth repeating, I'm afraid.
The %1$s: %2$s of us, on the %3$s path, led by Sect Master %4$s at %5$s.
Our enemies, the %s, lie %s of here.
The %1$s: %2$s of us, on the %3$s path.
The %1$s: %2$s of us, on the %3$s path. I lead it.
%1$s. I'm only a mortal, Immortal. I have no cultivation to speak of.
I'm about %s%% of the way through this stage.
%1$s, at %2$s. I answer to no sect, and to no one.
%1$s. %2$s. I go where the qi is.
I am %1$s, a wandering cultivator at %2$s. No sect, only the road.
